# Environment variables

Every environment variable the code reads, found by scanning it (so this page cannot miss one): Python `os.environ`, Java `Env.str / integer / lng` and `System.getenv`. *Default* is the value used when the variable is unset (as written in the code); *compose* lists the services of `deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml` that set it. Secrets (Kafka SASL passwords, the console token) come from the environment only and are never logged.
